name: zn-gate
description: Local security layer for OpenAI Codex: blocks reads and writes of secret files, shell commands and MCP calls that would handle a secret, and prompts that contain one. Runs a pinned, verified copy of zn-gate that ships inside the plugin; no account and no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps secret values out of what Codex runs and sends to its model
interface.longDescription: Checks every shell command, patch, MCP call and prompt for secrets before Codex runs it. Its hooks must be reviewed and trusted once with /hooks. No account, no API key, nothing is sent over the network.
